products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.69
products.summary: 1.69 英寸 240×280；16 MiB Flash / 8 MiB PSRAM。
limitations: 部分适配：真实ESP32-S3数字板级路径，完整应用、无线、模拟电源和实物未验收。
厂家资料、CAD和原始固件校验可追溯；未知版次、机械偏差与实际运行失败均保留。
CurrentV2.1 schematic and earlier schematic both retained; unmarked CAD revision is not promoted to V2.1 PCB placement evidence.

Original factory reachesSetup done and discovers15/51/6B; at5s it emits10 RAMWR commands and1929 finalRGB565 colors. Espressif mode3 idleHigh=true,outEdge=false is independently tested; full application/input acceptance remains unverified.

ST7789V2 actualGRAM is240×320 with manufacturerY20 offset. Fixed portrait reference uses factoryMADCTL00; LCMCTRL XMX/XMY scan is separate from hostMADCTL. Physical orientation/color/gamma and LCM XBGR/XMV/XINV remain uncalibrated.
All native source topology preserved without scale fitting. Native materials are not calibrated hardware color.
Physical3D switch/connector calibration is not established; no guessed button targets or connected cables. Workbench inputs remain separately available.
No hardware fit, optical alignment, browser WebGL or full factory application acceptance claim.

Source native33.13×41.13 cover agrees with publishedXY. Active center is registered to source origin; independent optical calibration is not established. V2.1 schematic source is retained independently from CAD revision.
